query.title: Query
query.description: Encoded query ANDed into every range (no ^NQ), e.g. active=true

startField.title: Start field
startField.description: Date or date-time field that places the event

endField.title: End field
endField.description: Optional; empty = one-hour events (one day for dates)

colorField.title: Colour by
colorField.description: Field whose value colours the events (state / priority use status colours)

views.title: Views offered
views.description: Comma list (empty = month, week, day, agenda)

reschedule.title: Drag to reschedule
reschedule.description: Writes the start / end fields as the user (form save, Undo toast)

recordPage.title: Record page
recordPage.description: Portal page events open on (table / sys-id); empty = the classic form

cardFields.title: Card fields
cardFields.description: Comma list for the event cards (empty = app/record-card defaults)
